displayPattern: Washer display shows UE (also shown as Ub, U6, Ur, 1 Ub or 1U6 on some models)
meaning: Unbalanced load error: the load is unbalanced inside the tub. Ur means the washer will add water, try to rebalance the load and retry the spin; Ur does not mean there is a problem.
causes: Unbalanced or tangled load in the tub
diySteps: Untangle and rearrange the laundry so it is more balanced in the tub
Close the door and restart the cycle (press Start)
safetyNote: Unplug the washer (or switch off its breaker) and close the water taps before you reach behind it, handle hoses or open a filter. Water left from a recent hot cycle can be very hot, so let it cool first. Never bypass the door lock. Motor, pump, valve, sensor and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: If you keep getting this error, follow Samsung's "Washer won't spin" guide.
sourceTitle: Samsung washing machine information and error codes (Samsung Support)
